name: Shirahato Inori
source:
A self-proclaimed “angel” who is a crossdressing boy.
He has a mysteriously beautiful appearance that captivates everyone.
He doesn’t attend school and is naive about the world.
He has no friends because whenever he speaks, his words tend to be provocative.
He spends his time with a “god” that no one else can see, and secretly collects semen for this god.
